summary: Procore Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement on July 27, 2026, to acquire DroneDeploy, a drone/robotics cloud software company, for approximately $845 million in cash via a merger subsidiary, with DroneDeploy surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Closing is expected by end of 2026, subject to DroneDeploy stockholder adoption, regulatory approvals including HSR waiting period, and customary conditions. A retention pool of equity/cash will incentivize key service providers. Procore obtained representations and warranties insurance; customary indemnification and termination rights apply. Watch for regulatory clearances and closing conditions as the deal progresses.
